notes: The italic *others* joins כֹּל's unit as a supplied generic under rule 31 rather than being marked added; the chain's *of* stands before *all* and so belongs to that rectum (rule 19).
*on every side* for מִסָּבִיב divides into *on* for the preposition and *every side* for the adverb, headed on the content word the phrase turns on (rule 24).
